source_title: Samsung UK Black Friday 2026 deals offer discounts on latest products
source_excerpt:
SamMobile has affiliate and sponsored partnerships, we may earn a commission .
Samsung has announced its Black Friday 2026 deals for customers in the United Kingdom. There are great deals on offer across a wide variety of its latest products.
Black Friday 2026 is still about a month away as it falls on November 27. Customers in the UK can visit Samsung's website to get early access to its Black Friday 2026 deals from November 4.
The company is offering a £250 discount on the Galaxy S26 from October 28 to November 17. Its Black Friday promise guarantees that if you find it cheaper at selected online retailers from November 4 to December 1, it will return the difference to you.
If you're in the market for a tablet, you can get up to £140 on the Galaxy Tab S12 Series with promo code BLACK1 . It's also offering up to £75 off the Galaxy Tab S10 FE Series when you pay with PayPal.
There's a £50 discount on offer for the Galaxy Watch 9 with promo code BFW as well as an up to £50 discount on the Galaxy Buds 4 and the Galaxy Buds 4 Pro .
Customers in the market for a new TV will like this offer. Samsung is letting them claim VAT back on selected Micro RGB and The Frame TVs, plus up to £150 off when they recycle their old TVs with Samsung.
Additional offers on a variety of Samsung home appliances are also available, so do check out Samsung UK's dedicated Black Friday 2026 deals page for more.
